theorem: Every finite-sampling C_s edge-supported state has a canonical D6 first-sector monotone boundary word in the AF alphabet 1=(0,1), 2=(-1,1), 3=(-1,0).

lemmas.baseline: Every dual vertex in the D6 hexball H_r is C_s-supported: in a nonnegative sector the relevant inward support triangle has vertex sums <=r, hence Q(x,y)<= (x+y)^2 <= r^2 for the entire triangle.
lemmas.support_dominance: For a>=b>=0, p=(a,b) is edge-supported iff the limiting inward triangle U(a-1,b) passes the C_s majority rule; reflection across the inward shared edge bijects its microcentroids to the companion D triangle and weakly decreases Q, while every other support pair is no more inward.
lemmas.shell_balance: For fixed shell m=a+b, C_s support is maximized at a=ceil(m/2), b=floor(m/2); tangential compression toward a=b preserves shell coordinate and weakly decreases the paired Q values because Q=3(x+y)^2/4+(x-y)^2/4.
lemmas.shell_interval: Supported vertices on a fixed shell form the reflection-symmetric interval around the balanced vertex; accepted shells are initial in m.
lemmas.single_peak: The sector boundary is therefore a nonnegative single-peak Motzkin excursion; all 1 events precede all 3 events and reflection exchanges 1<->3 while fixing 2.

definitions.M_C_s(r): largest supported shell a+b in the canonical sector; M_C_s(0)=0
